title: Good and easy to use
body:
It’s been few months since I have started using it and I must say I am totally attached to this app. All of my habits I can track it easily and perfectly. I can also see if I am missing some habits with the dates as well.
I got to know about this app from the YouTube channel- The Studio
author: abedinayan1105

title: Clean and simple to use
body:
I love how the app is clean and simple, something that is missing in the majority of the apps today. 
I just couldn’t figure how to change the icon of the habit 🤔 but maybe it’s a paid feature.
author: Lyamtt

title: Awesome for tracking habits
body:
I have been using this app for almost 2-3 years now. It’s simple yet shows exactly what is needed. Great app! 
One suggestion would be if we can add a note to each task in the day that way people can track their own notes/comments about how the task went on a certain day.
author: sr2026-new

title: Good App, but doesn’t support Family Sharing
body: I do like the app, however it doesn’t support family sharing so I will probably uninstall it and try another.
author: MrMrH123

title: Best intuitive tracker app
body:
A very to the point and intuitive app to track any habits you may want to track!
Did I read a book today? Check
Did I go to the gym today? Check
Did I order food today? Check
Etc… 

It can be as simple or as complex and you want!

Highly recommended!

The dev is responsive and rolling out update following the end user feedback!

5 stars
author: Paubery

title: Perfect
body: This app has just the features that I need for tracking new habits. I especially like the iOS widgets. The developer is also responsive and receptive to feedback for new features. Definitely recommend!
author: tomwbarlow

title: Look no further for activities tracking
body:
HabitKit’s simplicity makes your life organised and enjoyable to track. 
Sebastian, the HabitKit’s developer, is passionate and enthusiastic about the app and takes users’ feedback seriously which makes the app alive and exciting to use. I’m looking forward to upcoming features and continuous development.
Great job Sebastian!
author: Jacekcito
